stitch.description: Google Stitch MCP — AI UI/UX design and code generation. Generate screens, list projects, download HTML/Tailwind UI assets.

filesystem.description: MCP filesystem server — read/write/list files and directories in the workspace. Useful for file-based operations, reading project assets, and managing uploads.

memory.description: MCP memory server — persistent knowledge graph memory across sessions. Store and retrieve entities, relations, and observations for clients and brands.

context7.description: Context7 MCP — up-to-date library documentation for any npm package, framework, or tool. Resolve /use [library-name] to inject accurate docs into code generation.

puppeteer.description: Puppeteer MCP — browser automation: navigate URLs, take screenshots, extract page content, fill forms, click elements. Use for web scraping, visual audits, and page analysis.

everything.description: MCP everything server — comprehensive test server with prompts, resources, sampling, and tool demonstrations. Use for testing MCP integrations and protocol features.
